incidents.title: Retool breached via SMS phishing and deepfaked employee voice
incidents.outcome: Attacker obtained an MFA code by phone and took over an employee's account; 27 cloud customers were affected and crypto customers lost funds.
incidents.confidenceReason: Retool says in its own post that the caller "deepfaked our employee's actual voice", a first-hand public account with specifics, but shows no recording or artifact. That makes it Strong, not Confirmed.
incidents.summary: An employee clicked an SMS phishing link to a fake portal. The attacker then phoned the employee, using a deepfaked voice of a real colleague, and obtained the MFA code needed to take over the account.
incidents.quote: the attacker called the employee. The caller claimed to be one of the members of the IT team, and deepfaked our employee's actual voice.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Retool has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

harness.note: Deepfake/impersonation tool only, no agent harness

incidents.title: Hong Kong police arrest 6 in crackdown on fraud syndicate using AI deepfake technology to apply for loans
incidents.outcome: Fraudulent online loan applications to financial institutions; six arrested.
incidents.confidenceReason: SCMP quotes Superintendent Dicken Ko Tik verbatim: 'The racket used an AI face-changing programme, commonly known as deepfake technology, to apply for loans online', with six arrested. The police statement, quoted directly by SCMP, is the primary source.
incidents.summary: Hong Kong police said a syndicate used an AI face-changing program to apply for loans online with financial institutions, the first time they had found deepfakes used to deceive them.
incidents.quote: The racket used an AI face-changing programme, commonly known as deepfake technology, to apply for loans online with financial institutions
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only South China Morning Post has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.
